suggestions.quote: A whole metro carriage of counters, every one falling a little as the doors close
suggestions.fix: The metro carriage is the likeliest long pole, since it is a new set with a crowd. Build it as one drifting side-on layer: a window strip plus 5 to 6 repeated seated or standing figures, each with the same split-flap counter prop on a shared 'fall by one' action. Mom's counter is the only one that gets a close-up. Name the carriage and the counter-over-head prop as the new kit items, and reuse the pause-time bus-shelter and street layers for the platform.

suggestions.quote: Counters everywhere. The metro stranger: four hundred (your commute). The annoying colleague: three thousand. Your crush: two.
suggestions.fix: Stage this as one street layer and one office layer that reuse the counter prop and the boss and kid stock figures from the kit. Use a single dolly past a row of figures, each with a tag, instead of separate sets. The crimson stranger can be the metro stranger, so cast.md's hidden-stranger rule is met without a new rig.

suggestions.quote: a transfer abroad that sets it to nine
suggestions.fix: Do not build an abroad set. Show the transfer as a bubble or tag on a phone or boarding pass in front of the existing home door set, with the counter flipping to 9. That keeps the choice at 78% inside sets already built.

suggestions.quote: you wave without looking up from the phone
suggestions.fix: Define this as the trigger gesture: a half-wave with the phone held up. Repeat it exactly in the 'weekend home' and festival beats, and mirror it in the final turn-round wave at the corner so the change reads as a flipped action.

suggestions.quote: A counter over mom's head says forty-two, and it drops every time you leave her
suggestions.fix: Settle the colour rule for the rule device now. Suggested: the counter and your figure keep full colour, and the other counters sit in paper-cream and ink so mom's is the only one lit. Mom's counter should be the one mustard or crimson accent per scene, which keeps the frame readable on a phone.

suggestions.quote: mom's falls by one as your train leaves after a weekend home
suggestions.fix: Cue sheet note for G2: `cues.yaml` is not in my inputs, so I cannot check sound.md #1 or #3. When it is written, give each beat a one-word intent (e.g. warm, cold, hollow, lift). Keep music in and out on named cues. Keep the intent from changing until the counter drops or climbs, never before it. The 'it climbs' reversal in the third jump should change the music at or after that flip.

suggestions.quote: We never see the new number.
suggestions.fix: Put the last wordless peak (8 to 10 s) on the corner turn. Keep the camera drifting slowly, with mom small at the door and the counter just out of frame. Leave the right third quiet for end screens.

keep.quote: You leave home, and at the corner you turn round and wave back
You find the counter counts your habits, not her years: it moves when you do
mom's falls by one as your train leaves after a weekend home
